thread:
carmen: Quick thread to capture a few design choices for onboarding. I'm worried the current 'bench single pipeline' approach couples too many concerns: sampling, golden diffs, cost accounting, and runtime contract versions. Need a refactor.

ishaan: +1. We should separate concerns into: sampler (what to run), verifier (how to compare), and policy engine (promotion/cost). Each piece should have a minimal stable interface.

rebecca: Agree. For sampler I'm proposing a delta-sampler service that supports deterministic strata + adaptive budget. API sketch: lane, strata_weights, max_samples, stop_ci. That lets CI call small-sample runs while bench-fleet can use larger budgets.

mohit: For verifier we need a compact "fingerprint diff" artifact instead of full diffs for quick triage. Fingerprint = stable hash of normalized token stream + harness_version. Also include top-k token mismatches and a small context window. Example payload: `fingerprint: 6c4f8a...`, `top_mismatches: [{seed:123, diff: "the->a"}]`.

carmen: Important: runtime contract versioning. Prober, runtime, and ingest should all advertise a contract_version in the handshake. If contract_version mismatch, ingest should fail fast with a clear error. No silent fallbacks.

ishaan: Handshake proto example:
```
handshake:
  lane: "smoke"|"delta"|"golden"
  contract_version: "v2"
  simulate_prefix: "none"|"short"|"runtime"
  golden_fingerprint: ""
  max_retries: 1
  harness_version: "2026-03-12"
```

rebecca: Also add `cost_estimate_usd` in the registration metadata so teams know expected spend before triggering a golden. That ties into the policy engine which can auto-approve small overruns and flag large ones for manual review.

mohit: On promotion policy, let's introduce three built-in policies: fast-track (smoke + delta pass), conservative (require golden pass within 48h), and gated (manual sign-off). Make it configurable per-model.

prober-bot: scheduled: delta-sampler run for rwi-proto-7 (100 seq, strata=short:0.6,med:0.3,long:0.1) ETA 13m - artifact:/bench/art/1865432205

ishaan: Triage UX: delta runs should produce a single-line result for PR checks (PASS/FLAG) plus a triage link. If FLAG, attach fingerprint and 3 replay commands to reproduce locally. Example repro snippet:
```
rwi prober reproduce --job 1865432205 --seed 34 --lane delta
```

rebecca: We should also surface a "compat matrix" per model that lists supported runtime variants, quantization levels, and observed regression risk. The bench verifier should update that matrix after full golden runs. Over time that becomes a searchable compatibility graph.

mohit: Ops note: set artifact TTLs: smoke 2d, delta 10d, golden 45d. Bench infra should GC and emit an event when artifacts are pruned so we don't point at dead links.

carmen: Security/compliance: add optional `owner_approval_hash` for private deployments so golden runs that touch customer data require an owner HMAC before promotion.

ishaan: Metrics to track: pass_rate_by_lane, p99_latency_by_lane, divergence_rate, and bench_spend_by_model. Also compute a moving "regression_pressure" score to trigger targeted deep-golden runs.

rebecca: Implementation steps: (1) formalize handshake proto and contract_versioning, (2) build delta-sampler service + CLI support, (3) add fingerprint diff format and index, (4) policy engine for promotion & cost controls, (5) compat-matrix dashboards + TTL enforcement. I'll draft an RFC and include examples + thresholds.

mohit: I'll prototype the fingerprint normalization and a small Go lib that produces the 64-char fingerprint. Keep it idempotent across harness versions.

ci-bot: note: please add tests for contract_version mismatch behavior in ingest tests.

carmen: If there are no objections I'll open the RFC later today and tag bench/orch/infra/finance/security. Thanks all. :rocket:
